$about: Clip coverage registry, read by tools/walkthrough/compile.mjs gate 13 (job #854, 2026-09-15). Every HANDBOOK capability is stepped by a walk, or listed here under capabilities.obvious with a sentence on why nobody needs showing, or under capabilities.missing as honest backlog. Every routed page carries an anchor or is listed under pages. The gate fails the build on anything in none of those, and on a line here whose subject has since gained a walk or an anchor — remove the line, the debt is paid. Never add a line to silence the gate for something that genuinely needs showing: that is what missing is for, with a note.
